written.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for ChatGPT Work and Codex
written.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API with improvements in professional outputs, coding, and efficiency. Astra's standard input and output prices are 20 percent lower than the previous version, while Sol offers lower-cost everyday performance.

written.headline: Microsoft and Salesforce announce Copilotforce partnership
written.summary: Microsoft and Salesforce announced Copilotforce, a partnership that integrates Salesforce customer context and actions into Microsoft AI tools like Copilot, Teams, and Fabric. The announcement was made on November 17, 2026.

written.headline: Microsoft introduces new Copilot features and IQ platform at Ignite 2026
written.summary: Microsoft announced new AI innovations at Ignite 2026, including Copilot Workspaces, Autopilot, and the Microsoft IQ enterprise context management platform. Volkswagen Group is equipping over 330,000 employees with Copilot.
